author: Grace Samels
title: Embassy Theatre partners with Blue Jacket for Christmas season ticket bundle - NewsBreak
text:
By Grace Samels ,
1 hours ago
FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WANE) -- In its 42nd year, the Embassy Theatre's annual Festival of Trees will come with two extra events this Christmas season.
Both Fort Wayne favorites, the Festival of Trees and the Fantasy of Lights, can be attended with the purchase of just one ticket after the Embassy Theatre and Blue Jacket announced their Holiday Classics Bundle on Thursday. The bundle includes admission to the Fantasy of Lights for one vehicle and up to six people to the Festival of Trees. The deal goes for as long as the Festival of Trees is open, which is from Nov. 25 through Dec. 2.
Thursday, the Embassy announced the deal, along with an event new this year: the Black Friday Bookish Pop-Up. On Nov. 27, from 10:30 p.m. to 12:30 a.m., book lovers have the opportunity to shop a curated collection of books and accessories among the decked-out Christmas trees.
Returning this year is Midnight Madness, a late-night opening for the festival, where lights will be dimmed to let the trees shine. Breakfast with Santa is also making a comeback this Christmas season.
Tickets for the Festival of Trees, including the bundle, can be found on the Embassy Theatre's website .
